```{css echo=FALSE}
.embed-container {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 100%;
    height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 100%;
}

.embed-container iframe,
.embed-container object,
.embed-container embed {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}
```

```{=html}
<div class="embed-container">
  <iframe src="`r rmarkdown::metadata$cv$pdf`" style="border: 0.2px"></iframe>
</div>

<p class="text-center">
  <a class="btn btn-primary btn-lg cv-download" href="`r rmarkdown::metadata$cv$pdf`" target="_blank">
    <i class="fa-solid fa-file-arrow-down"></i>&ensp;Download current CV
  </a>
</p>
```
